description: While states of India are in a race to use Artificial Intelligence, its largest state, Uttar Pradesh, has gone a step ahead with the plans to build the country’s first AI city in Lucknow to house and promote the AI ecosystem.
body_lead: Results for " While states of India are in a race to use Artificial Intelligence, its largest state, Uttar Pradesh, has gone a step ahead with the plans to build the country’s first AI city in Lucknow to house and promote the AI ecosystem. According to a report by Grand View Research, the global AI market size reached $137 billion in 2022 and is expected to expand at a compound annual growth rate of 37.3% from 2023 to 2030. Lucknow houses Centres of Excellence in domains like AI and MedTech.
